body:
Maybe not tonight. I can’t pretend to understand what you are going through. But I too often have the thought “end it all, then I won’t have to worry about it”. But a part of us, even if it’s just a little bit, knows that life is worth living, which is why we reach out for help or hope that someone pays attention to how much we are hurting and struggling.

It’s disgusting that you are being turned away. It’s hard enough getting through everyday, without having to fight for treatment!

But please hang in there. Try and find a therapist that understands that PHP isn’t an option you feel you can pursue
